text: 閉殻Hartree–Fock方程式 Closed-shell Hartree–Fock equations 閉殻Hartree–Fock方程式 \hat F=\hat h+\sum_{j\in\mathrm{occ}}(2\hat J_j-\hat K_j),\qquad \hat F\phi_i=\varepsilon_i\phi_i \mathbf F\mathbf C=\mathbf S\mathbf C\boldsymbol\varepsilon,\qquad \mathbf C^\dagger\mathbf S\mathbf C=\mathbf I 閉殻RHFの占有空間軌道の式で、非局所交換を含む。既存のHe局所還元とH2のRHF例を保持する。追加は固定H2/H3+の最小2電子模型で、UHF式は別の対応模型に明示する。一般多中心分子、開殻の大域安定性、完全基底や一般相関法の保証ではない。 Closed-shell Hartree–Fock equations \hat F=\hat h+\sum_{j\in\mathrm{occ}}(2\hat J_j-\hat K_j),\qquad \hat F\phi_i=\varepsilon_i\phi_i \mathbf F\mathbf C=\mathbf S\mathbf C\boldsymbol\varepsilon,\qquad \mathbf C^\dagger\mathbf S\mathbf C=\mathbf I Closed-shell occupied-orbital RHF equations include nonlocal exchange. Preserve existing He local-reduction and H2RHF examples. New calculations cover only fixed minimal two-electron H2/H3+ models; UHF equations have their own mapped model. No general multicenter molecules, global open-shell stability, complete-basis or general correlated-method guarantee. hartree-fock-model 閉殻Hartree–Fock方程式 Closed-shell Hartree–Fock equations 方程式 モデル equation model
